Privacy policy

A clear outline of the minimum data that may be processed when you use this guide.

7.6094° S 110.1778° EFIELD NOTE
Updates

Updates

This document applies from 21 October 2026. We review it when the way this website operates changes.

Information we may collect

Information we may collect

We process only the minimum information needed to operate the site, such as technical browsing data (IP address, browser type and pages viewed), cookies and similar technologies. This site has no accounts, bookings, contact form or email submission address.

How we use it

How we use it

Data is used to maintain and improve the reading experience, understand aggregate usage patterns, and meet applicable legal obligations.

Cloudflare hosting performance

Cloudflare hosting performance

Cloudflare hosting injects a Cloudflare Insights (RUM) beacon separately from Google Analytics. It may send page performance metrics, URLs and referrers to Cloudflare. Cloudflare documents that the beacon uses no cookies or browser storage and discards the request IP address at its nearest data center. This site’s Google Analytics control does not control the hosting beacon. Script presence does not establish successful metric delivery.

Third-party services

Third-party services

The embedded Google map and Google Fonts load as third-party resources, and Google Analytics is loaded only when you consent to analytics cookies. These services maintain their own privacy policies.

Your rights

Your rights

Reject or withdraw analytics through Cookie settings. Withdrawal immediately disables further Google Analytics measurement; data already sent is not recalled. Use browser settings to clear local storage and third-party cookies; saved choices apply only to this browser.
